blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation.
Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs.
However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored.
Through post-training looped transformers, we study the accuracy–compute slope, measured as the accuracy gain per doubling of test-time decoding FLOPs.
We find that existing looped transformers often yield steeper slopes than their non-looped baseline, yet underperform it at matched compute .
While fixed-depth looping spends extra iterations on every token, our analysis show that many tokens do not benefit from extra iterations.
We therefore propose TaH2, which enables the model to focus extra iterations on the tokens that benefit from looping.
It jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider through lookahead depth supervision , which uses online labels indicating whether further iteration improves the prediction.
TaH2 improves both the efficiency and attainable accuracy of test-time scaling.
On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 improves the accuracy–compute slope by 53% (2.74 vs. 1.79) over the non-looped baseline, exceeding the baseline’s peak accuracy by about 3.4 points at matched test-time compute.
As the maximum iteration depth increases, existing looped models largely plateau, while TaH2’s gain over the non-looped baseline continues to grow from +2.8 points at depth 2 to +3.9 points at depth 8.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional inference compute ( Jaech et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Snell et al., 2024 ) .
This computation can support longer chains of thought in token space ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) , or repeated applications of shared layers in latent space, as in looped transformers ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Geiping et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
Parameter sharing makes additional depth possible without increasing model size, but each iteration still incurs decoding cost.
Prior scaling studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameter counts or per-token FLOPs ( Prairie et al., 2026 ; Schwethelm et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
These comparisons do not establish whether looping improves accuracy–compute scaling as output-token budgets increase.
We study this question through post-training, a practical way to introduce recurrence into pretrained LLMs without training a looped model from scratch ( McLeish et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Fu et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh:
测试时间缩放通过花费额外的推论计算来改进语言模型推理(Jaech等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;Snell等人,2024年).
这一计算可以支持代号空间(Muennighoff等人,2025年)中更长的思维链,或者像环绕变压器(Dehghani等人,2019年;Geiping等人,2025年a;Zhu等人,2025年)那样,在潜在空间中重复应用共享层。
参数共享可以在不增加模型大小的情况下增加深度,但每次迭代仍然需要解码费用.
先前的缩放研究在匹配参数计数或每桶FLOP时比较循环模型和非螺旋模型(Prairie等人,2026年;Schwethelm等人,2026年b;Wang等人,2026年b).
这些比较不能确定循环是否提高准确性----随着产出计数预算的增加而计算规模。
我们通过培训后研究这一问题,这是在不从零开始培训的循环模型的情况下将再现引入预先培训的有限责任公司的实际方法(McLeish等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年b;Fu等人,2025年b)。

blocks.en:
Using the same pretrained checkpoint and post-training data, we compare Standard (the non-looped baseline) with two principal looped architectures: full-stack recurrence in Ouro (at fixed depth or with its adaptive exit gate), and middle-block recurrence in Huginn ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Geiping et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026a ) .
By varying the output-token cutoff up to 16K at test time, we measure the scaling slope as the accuracy gain per doubling of decoding FLOPs.
In this post-training setting, fixed-depth and adaptive Ouro (maximum iteration depth M = 2 M=2 ) and Huginn ( M = 3 M=3 ) yield steeper scaling slopes than Standard ( 2.12 2.12 , 2.27 2.27 and 2.26 2.26 versus 1.79 1.79 ), yet remain less accurate over the overlapping compute range (Figure 1(a) ).
This motivates our central question:
blocks.zh:
使用同样的经过预先训练的检查站和培训后数据,我们比较了标准(未铺设的基线)和两个主要的环绕结构:Ouro的全层复发(在固定深度或其适应性出口门处)和Huginn的中层复发(Zhu等人,2025年;Geiping等人,2025年a); 黄等, 2026a ).
通过在测试时间将输出键切换到16K,我们把缩放坡度测量为每双倍的解码FLOP的精度增益.
在这种训练后设置中,固定深度和适应性的Ouro(最大重力深度M = 2 M = 2 M = 2)和Huginn(M = 3 M = 3 )比标准(2.12 2.12,2.27 2.27和2.26 2.26 相对于1.79 1.79 )产生更陡峭的缩放坡度,但在重叠计算范围(图1(a))上仍然不太准确.
这引发了我们的中心问题:

blocks.en: How to post-train looped LLMs to outperform non-looped LLMs at the same test-time compute?
blocks.zh: 如何在同一试验时间计算训练后循环的LLMs以超过非LLMs?

blocks.en:
Fixed-depth iteration spends extra compute on every token, although many tokens gain little or even get worse (Section 3.2 ).
Ouro’s adaptive exit gate improves compute efficiency, but not enough to surpass Standard.
We introduce TaH2 to improve test-time scaling by learning which tokens benefit from additional iterations and allocating depth accordingly.
The backbone and an iteration decider are jointly post-trained through lookahead depth supervision : depth labels are derived online from changes in prediction loss, and a cost-sensitive loss supervises each depth decision (Figure 2 ).
Unlike TaH’s staged training with offline mismatch labels ( Fu et al., 2025b ) , TaH2 supervises depth decisions using actual iteration gains measured on the current backbone throughout training.
In addition, an updater provides input injection between iterations ( Geiping et al., 2025a ) , and stopping probabilities weight the predictions across executed depths ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
固定的深度迭代在每一个信物上都花费额外的计算,尽管许多信物得到的收益很少甚至越来越差(第3.2节)。
Ouro的适应性退出门提高了计算效率,但不足以超越标准。
我们采用TaH2,通过学习改进测试时间的缩放,通过增加迭代和相应分配深度,使这些标志受益。
骨干和一个迭代决定器通过望头深度监督进行联合培训后:深度标签通过预测损失的变化在线生成,成本敏感损失监督每个深度决定(图2)。
与TaH的舞台培训使用离线不匹配标签(Fu等人,2025年b)不同,TaH2在整个培训过程中利用目前主干线测量的实际迭代收益来监督深度决定。
此外,一个更新器在迭代之间提供输入注入(Geiping等人,2025a),并停止跨执行深度的预测概率加权(Zeng等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
We post-train Qwen3-Base models ( Yang et al., 2025 ) on general-domain data and evaluate them on math, code, QA and tool use benchmarks.
On AIME24–26 at 1.7B, TaH2 improves the accuracy–compute slope by 53 % 53\% over the non-looped baseline ( 2.74 2.74 vs. 1.79 1.79 points per doubling of decoding FLOPs).
With evaluation extended to 32K tokens, TaH2 exceeds Standard’s peak accuracy by about 3.4 3.4 points at matched decoding FLOPs (Figure 4(b) ).
Existing looped models largely plateau as iteration depth increases, while TaH2’s gain over the non-looped baseline grows from + 2.8 +2.8 points at M = 2 M=2 to + 3.9 +3.9 points at M = 8 M=8 (Figure 1(b) ).
TaH2’s gains persist at larger scales (4B and 8B) and generalise beyond math to code, QA and tool use (Table 3 ).

我们在一般域数据上对Qwen3-Base模型(Yang等人,2025年)进行后培训,并在数学,代码,QA和工具使用基准上对其进行评价.
在1.7B的AIME24-26上,TaH2提高了精度-计算坡度53%-53%**=非铁皮基线(2.742.74比1.791.79分) 。
随着评价扩展至32K令牌,TaH2在匹配的解码FLOP(图4(b))时超过了标准的峰值精度约3.43.4分.
现有的循环模型主要随着迭代深度的增大而高原化,而TaH2相对于非螺旋基线的增益则从M=2 M=2的+2.8+2.8点增长到M=8 M=8的+3.9+3.9点(图1(b)).
TaH2的收益持续在更大的尺度上(4B和8B),并超越数学,概括到代码,QA和工具使用(表3).

blocks.en:
We summarise our contributions as follows. • Test-Time Scaling of Looped Models .
We study how looping changes accuracy–compute scaling and find that, although post-trained looped models often yield steeper slopes, they underperform Standard at matched test-time compute. • Adaptive Looped Post-training .
We propose TaH2, which jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider, directly supervising depth decisions with online labels indicating whether further iteration improves prediction. • Improved Test-Time and Depth Scaling .
On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 yields a steeper accuracy–compute slope than Standard and achieves about 3.4 3.4 points higher accuracy at matched compute when Standard plateaus.
As the maximum iteration depth increases from 2 2 to 8 8 , its gain over Standard grows from + 2.8 +2.8 points to + 3.9 +3.9 points.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling .
Test-time compute can be increased by producing more tokens or repeatedly applying a shared block in latent space.
Token-based methods generate longer chains of thought ( Jaech et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , with reasoning length controlled through test-time budget forcing or RL ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ) .
They also explore multiple reasoning paths through repeated sampling ( Brown et al., 2024 ) or tree search ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024b ) .
In latent space, latent optimization replaces intermediate text with continuous representations ( Hao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , while looped transformers repeatedly apply shared layers before generating each token ( Geiping et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
We study how looping changes accuracy–compute scaling as output budgets increase, comparing post-trained looped and non-looped models at matched decoding FLOPs (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh:
测试时间缩放 。
试验时间计算可以通过产生更多的符号或者在潜在空间中反复应用共享块来增加.
基于Token的方法产生更长的思维链(Jaech等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年),通过测试时间预算强迫或RL控制推理长度(Muennighoff等人,2025年;Aggarwal和Welleck,2025年)。
他们还通过重复采样(Brown等人,2024年)或树探寻(Snell等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年b)探索多种推理路径.
在潜在空间中,潜在优化用连续表示取代中间文本(Hao等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年),而循环变压器在生成每个令牌之前反复应用共享层(Geiping等人,2025年a; 朱等, 2025 (中文(简体) ).
我们研究循环如何改变精度 — — 随着产出预算的增加而计算规模,在匹配的解码FLOP(第3节)中比较经过训练的后循环模型和非螺旋模型。

blocks.en:
Looped transformers .
Looped transformers increase effective depth through parameter sharing ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ) .
Architectures differ in the span they repeat: Huginn loops a middle block ( Geiping et al., 2025a ) , Ouro the full stack ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and Loopies individual layers ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
Recent scaling studies examine recurrence under matched parameter counts ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) , matched per-token FLOPs ( Schwethelm et al., 2026b ) , or both, as in SMELT ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
Recurrence can also be introduced into pretrained non-looped models through layer sharing ( Bae et al., 2024 ) or curriculum-based adaptation ( McLeish et al., 2025 ) .
TaH2 builds on this post-training setting to learn token-dependent iteration depths.
blocks.zh:
循环变压器。
循环变压器通过参数共享提高有效深度(Dehghani等人,2019年;Yang等人,2023年;Saunshi等人,2025年)。
其间距不同:Huginn环绕一个中间块(Geiping等人,2025a) , Ouro the full class (Zhu et al., 2025),以及Loopies个人层 (Gao et al., 2026).
最近的缩放研究在匹配参数计数(Prairie等人,2026年)下检查重现情况,每盘FLOPs对应(Schwethelm等人,2026年b),或两者兼有,如SMELT(Wang等人,2026年b)。
通过分层共享(Bae等人,2024年)或基于课程的调整(McLeish等人,2025年),也可以将重复引入经过预训的非螺旋模型.
TaH2基于这个培训后的设置来学习依赖符号的迭代深度.

blocks.en:
Adaptive computation .
Adaptive computation can operate along width, by selecting experts within layers ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) , or depth, through early exit ( Schuster et al., 2022 ) , layer skipping ( Raposo et al., 2024 ) or variable iteration counts ( Graves, 2016 ; Banino et al., 2021 ) .
Within looped models, methods differ in how they learn token-dependent iteration depth.
MoR trains routers under capacity constraints ( Bae et al., 2025 ) , while pondering methods combine prediction loss with budget or confidence penalties ( Li et al., 2026a ; Song et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
Other approaches learn stopping decisions from terminal rewards ( Kuo et al., 2026 ) or explicit labels: TaH uses offline mismatch labels in separate training stages ( Fu et al., 2025b ) , and Ouro’s second stage supervises its gate with token-level loss improvements while freezing the backbone ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
TaH2 jointly post-trains the backbone and decider through lookahead depth supervision , deriving online token-level labels from measured iteration gains along decider-selected routes.
Appendix E provides further comparisons and discusses scaling, state design and serving.
blocks.zh:
适应性计算.
适应性计算可以沿宽度运行,通过在层内选择专家(Fedus等人,2022年),或深度,通过早期退出(Shuster等人,2022年),层跳(Raposo等人,2024年)或可变迭代计数(Graves,2016年;Banino等人,2021年).
在循环模型中,方法在如何学习依赖符号的迭代深度上有所不同.
能力受限的MOR列车路由器 (Bae等人,2025年),同时思考方法将预测损失与预算或信心罚款结合起来(Li等人,2026a; Song et al., 2026; Zeng et al., 2026).
其他方法从终端奖励(Kuo等人,2026年)或明确标签中学习阻止决定:TaH在单独的训练阶段使用离线错配标签(Fu等人,2025b年),Ouo的第二阶段在冻结主干时用象征性的损失级改进来监督其大门(Zhu等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries

blocks.en: 3.2 Test-Time Scaling Behaviour

blocks.en:
Setup .
We post-train Standard, Ouro ( M = 2 M=2 ) and Huginn ( M = 3 M=3 ) from Qwen3-1.7B-Base on same data with a 16K context.
Huginn runs at fixed depth; Ouro is evaluated both at fixed depth and with its exit gate, trained afterwards on the frozen backbone (Appendix A.2 ).
We measure mean AIME24–26 accuracy with 32 samples per problem, sweeping output-token cutoffs from 4K to 16K in 2K increments.
We fit accuracy linearly against log 2 \log_{2} of the decoding FLOPs per response (Appendix A.4.2 ).
Further settings appear in Section 5.1 .

设置.
我们列车后标准,Ouro(M = 2 M = 2)和Huginn(M = 3 M = 3)从Quen3–1.7B-Base基于16K上下文的相同数据.
Huginn在固定深度运行;Ouro在固定深度及其出口门都得到评价,随后在冻结的骨干上接受培训(附录A.2 )。
我们测量的精度是AIME24-26,每个问题有32个样本,在2K增量中将输出切换从4K到16K。
我们按照每个响应的解码FLOP的正则2\log_{2}线性地匹配精确度(附录A.4.2)。
进一步设置见第5.1节。

blocks.en:
Results .
Fixed-depth Ouro, adaptive Ouro and Huginn yield slopes of 2.12 2.12 , 2.27 2.27 and 2.26 2.26 accuracy points per compute doubling, versus 1.79 1.79 for Standard (Figure 1(a) ), suggesting larger accuracy gains from latent computation as test-time compute increases.
Yet all three remain less accurate than Standard over the overlapping compute range; the exit gate lowers Ouro’s decoding cost but does not close the gap.
Recurrence has proven effective in pretraining, as in Ouro and Huginn, but our results point to a gap when it is introduced only in post-training:

但对于重叠计算范围而言,这三者都不如标准组织准确;退出门降低了Ouro的解码费用,但并没有缩小差距。
实践证明,如在Ouro和Huginn,再现在预训方面是有效的,但我们的结果表明,只有在后培训方面才出现差距:

blocks.en: Post-trained looped models gain accuracy faster as test-time compute increases, yet underperform the non-looped baseline at matched compute.
blocks.zh: 训练后循环模型随着测试时间计算量的提高而更快地获得精度,然而在匹配计算时却表现不佳,未用铁制的基线.

blocks.en:
Analysis and motivation .
To examine how fixed-depth iteration affects individual tokens, we compare next-token losses after the first and final iterations on the validation set.
Figure 3 shows the loss reduction from iterations → 2 1\!\to\!2 for Ouro and → 3 1\!\to\!3 for Huginn.
Both distributions concentrate near zero, and a substantial fraction of tokens obtain worse prediction loss after the additional iterations.
For Ouro and Huginn, respectively, 52.3 % 52.3\% and 33.5 % 33.5\% of tokens change by at most 10 − 3 10^{-3} , while 21.7 % 21.7\% and 15.9 % 15.9\% become worse by more than this threshold.
blocks.zh:
分析和动机
为了研究固定深度迭代如何影响单个代号,我们比较了第一次和最后一次迭代之后在验证集上的下一位代号损失.
图3显示Ouro和Huginn的重复损失减少量。
两种分布都集中在接近零处,大量信使在附加迭代后获得更糟糕的预测损失.
对Ouro和Huginn来说,分别为52.3 %和33.5%的代币变化最多为10-3 10⁄3⁄4,而21.7%的21.7⁄4和15.9%的15.9⁄4的代币变化超过这一阈值。

blocks.en:
Fixed-depth looping therefore spends additional iterations on many tokens that gain little or even get worse.
Ouro’s exit gate improves efficiency but still underperforms Standard at matched compute.
Its backbone is trained only at full depth, causing a train–inference mismatch under early exit.
This motivates learning token-dependent depth jointly with the backbone, supervised by measured loss reductions.
blocks.zh:
因此,固定的深层环绕会在收益很少甚至更糟的许多标志上花费额外的迭代.
Ouro 的退出门提高了效率,但仍表现不佳 符合计算标准 。
其骨干只在全深度训练,导致列车-推论在提前退出下出现不匹配.
这促使人们与骨干部门一起学习以象征为依存的深度,并辅之以衡量损失的减少。

blocks.en: 4 TaH2: Post-training Adaptive Looped Models
blocks.zh: 4 TaH2:培训后适应循环模型

blocks.en:
Building on Section 3 , TaH2 learns token-dependent depth through joint post-training of the backbone and decider.
We describe its architecture and training scheme below.
blocks.zh:
在第三节的基础上,TAH2通过骨干和决定者的联合后培训,学习了信物依赖深度.
下面我们介绍其结构和培训计划。

blocks.en: 4.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.1 结构

blocks.en:
TaH2 comprises a shared Transformer backbone, a learned input-injection updater, and a token-level iteration decider.
The updater and decider add fewer than 3 % 3\% parameters at every scale we study (Table 7 ).
Each iteration executes all L L backbone layers using extended duo-causal attention.

更新者和决定者在我们研究的每个尺度上添加不到3%的 3QQ 参数(表7).
每个迭代执行所有L L 骨干层 使用扩展的双因子关注。

blocks.en:
Extended duo-causal attention .
We extend TaH’s duo-causal attention ( Fu et al., 2025b ) to support training-time lookahead.
At depth m m , token t t attends to executed KV states at positions s ≤ t s\leq t and depths j ≤ m j\leq m .
During training, stopped tokens take an additional no-gradient iteration for supervision.
Lookahead queries cannot attend to other tokens’ lookahead states; all other attention follows the duo-causal rule (Appendix A.2.1 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: We summarise the key configuration here; full details are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们在此总结关键配置;详细情况见附录A。

blocks.en:
Models and baselines .
We use Qwen3-{1.7B, 4B, 8B}-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as backbones.
We use the 1.7B model in Section 5.2 , and the 4B and 8B models in Section 5.3 .
We compare TaH2 with the following baselines:
(1) Standard , the single-pass model ( M = 1 M=1 );
(2) TaH2-fixed , a variant of TaH2 without a decider that executes all M M iterations at every token position;
(3) Ouro , which loops all L L layers and carries the hidden state directly across iterations ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; and
(4) Huginn , which loops a middle span of layers, reinjects the pre-loop representation through an input adapter, and uses a fixed depth ( Geiping et al., 2025a ) .
All variants at a given scale use the same Qwen3 initialization and post-training recipe.
We train and evaluate TaH2-fixed and Ouro at M = 2 , 4 M=2,4 , and Huginn at M = 3 , 7 M=3,7 ; looping 14 of the 28 layers gives Huginn the same effective depths of 2 2 and 4 4 full-model passes, respectively.
Figure 4(a) reports mean iteration depth in units of a full L L -layer pass.

模型和基线

我们比较了TaH2与以下基线:
(1) 标准,单行道型号(M=1M=1);
(2) TaH2-fixed ,是TaH2的变体,没有决定器,在每个符号位置执行所有M M重迭;
(3) Ouro,它环绕所有L L层,并直接穿过迭代(Zhu等人,2025年);
(4) Huginn,它环绕一个中间层段,通过一个输入适配器重新投放前潜代表,并使用固定深度(Geiping等人,2025a) 。 。 。
所有特定规模的变种都使用相同的Quen3初始化和训练后配方.
我们以M=2,4M=2,4M=2,4,以及Huginn为M=3,7M=3,7进行训练和评价TaH2-fixed和Ouro;循环28层中的14层分别给予Huginn同样有效的深度2,2和4个全型通行证.

blocks.en:
Training setup .
Training data combine math, code and QA prompts from AM-Qwen3-Distilled ( a-m-team, 2025 ) with tool use samples from Nemotron-Agentic-v1 ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) .
For the experiments in Section 5.2 , we use 273K prompts with responses regenerated by Qwen3-8B, the best-performing teacher in our comparison of downstream student accuracy (Appendix B.1 ).
We train for three epochs with a 16,384-token context, totalling 3.4B training tokens.
Section 5.3 uses the original responses generated by Qwen3-235B-A22B and fixes the training budget at TPP = 2 \mathrm{TPP}=2 tokens per parameter for every model size.
A validation set of 1,000 samples randomly drawn from the training mixture is used for loss and token-level analyses.
blocks.zh:
培训设置.
训练数据结合了AM-Quen3-Distilled(a-m-team,2025年)的数学,代码和QA提示与Nemotron-Agentic-v1(NVIDIA,2025年)的工具使用样本.
对于第5.2节中的实验,我们使用273K提示,由Qune3-8B(我们比较下游学生准确性时表现最好的老师)重新生成反应(附录B.1 ).
我们为三个世纪训练 16,384个背景, 总计3.4B训练标志。
第5.3节使用由Qune3-235B-A22B生成的原始响应,并将培训预算固定在TPP=2\mathrm{TPP}=2令牌每个参数每个模型大小.
从培训混合物中随机抽取的1 000个样本用于损失和象征性分析。

Depth scaling .
Raising the depth ceiling benefits TaH2 but not the existing looped methods.
On validation loss (Figure 4(a) ), Ouro and Huginn remain at or above Standard at every ceiling, whereas both TaH2 variants lower the loss further as M M grows, with adaptive TaH2 reaching the lowest loss ( − 0.0106 -0.0106 versus Standard at M = 8 M=8 ); this advantage persists throughout training (Appendix C.1 ).
Across the ten benchmarks (Table 1 ), TaH2’s average gain over Standard grows from + 2.9 +2.9 points at M = 2 M=2 to + 4.8 +4.8 at M = 8 M=8 , whereas Huginn and Ouro stay close to Standard; Figure 1(b) shows the same trend on AIME24–26.

深度缩放 。
提高深度上限对TaH2有利,但对现有循环方法不利。
在审定损失(图4(a))中,Ouro和Huginn在每个上限都保持在或高于标准,而TaH2两个变体随着MM的增长而进一步降低损失,适应性的TaH2达到最低损失(0.0106-0.106相对于标准M=8 M=8);这一优势在整个培训期间一直存在(附录C.1)。
在10个基准(表1)中,TaH2比标准的平均增益从M=2M=2+2.9点增长到M=8M=8+4.8点,而Hugin和Ouro则接近标准;图1(b)显示AIME24-26的趋势相同。

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling .
As decoding FLOPs increase, TaH2 improves accuracy more efficiently than baselines and reaches a higher peak accuracy.
Within the 16K training length (Figure 1(a) ), TaH2 at M = 2 M=2 gains 2.74 2.74 points per doubling of decoding FLOPs, compared with 2.12 2.12 – 2.42 2.42 for other looped models and 1.79 1.79 for Standard.
Extending evaluation to 32K (Figure 4(b) ), Standard saturates at 12.0 % 12.0\% with 191.7 191.7 TFLOPs per response, whereas TaH2 reaches 15.4 % 15.4\% at the same compute, 3.4 3.4 points higher.
Larger ceilings ( M = 4 , 8 M=4,8 ) raise peak accuracy further, while M = 2 M=2 offers the best accuracy–compute trade-off among the three.
Appendix C.2 further shows these scaling curves on each benchmark.
TaH2 also improves parallel scaling through majority voting: AIME24–26 cons@32 reaches 27.3 27.3 – 29.3 % 29.3\% for M = 2 M=2 – 8 8 , versus 21.9 % 21.9\% for Standard (Appendix C.3 ).

在16K训练长度(图1(a))内,TaH2在M=2 M=2 增益2.74 2.74分每双倍的解码FLOP,而其他循环型号则有2.12 2.12 – 2.42 2.42,标准型则有1.79 1.79.

blocks.en:
Training scheme .
(1) Depth labels .
We compare gain-based labels with top-1 mismatch labels, which label a token to continue when its top-1 prediction differs from the target, as in TaH ( Fu et al., 2025b ) .
Mismatch labels reduce average accuracy by 1.1 1.1 points, as they only reflect whether the current prediction is correct, not whether further iteration actually improves it.
(2) Decider loss weights .
Weighting all decisions uniformly instead of by gain magnitude causes the largest drop, 3.6 3.6 points, and lowers accuracy on all three benchmarks.
(3) Gain coverage .
Retaining all positive gains ( ρ = 1 \rho=1 ) reduces average accuracy by 1.9 1.9 points, supporting the filtering of marginal gains to reduce label noise.
(4) Training decisions .
Sampling rather than thresholding continuation decisions during training reduces average accuracy by 1.3 1.3 points.
This suggests that consistent token selection across training and inference helps each depth specialise.
blocks.zh:
培训计划
(1)深度标签.
我们比较了基于增益的标签和顶级-1不匹配的标签,这些标签标注了当其顶级-1的预测与目标不同时要继续的标志,如TaH(Fu等人,2025b).
错位标签将平均精度降低1.11.1分,因为它们只反映当前预测是否正确,而不是进一步迭代是否真正改善了它.
(2) 裁判员减重。
统一而不是通过增量来权衡所有决定,造成最大下降,即3.63.6分,并降低所有三项基准的准确性。
(3) 扩大覆盖面。
保留所有正增益(^1\rho=1)将平均精度降低1.9分,支持过滤边增益以减少标签噪声.
(4) 培训决定。
在培训期间进行取样而不是确定继续决定的门槛值,平均准确度降低了1.3分。
这表明,在培训和推论中始终如一地选择符号有助于每个深度的专门化。

Model architecture .
(1) Updater .
We replace the learned updater with the probability-weighted sum of the top-100 token embeddings ( Fu et al., 2025b ) .
This alternative reduces average accuracy by 2.1 2.1 points, supporting learned state updates.
(2) Output .
Using only the final prediction reduces average accuracy by 1.0 1.0 point, supporting the stopping-weighted mixture.

blocks.zh: 5.5 进一步分析

blocks.en:
Decider–gain alignment .
For TaH2 ( M = 2 M=2 ) at 1.7B, we group validation tokens by continue probability and measure the mean loss reduction from a second iteration (Figure 6 ).
Tokens with probabilities near zero show negative or negligible gains, while mean gain increases with continue probability overall.
At the decision threshold of 0.5 0.5 , the corresponding loss reduction is near zero.
These results support the decider’s ability to direct additional iterations towards tokens that benefit more from them.
blocks.zh:
决定者- 复对齐 。
对于1.7B的TaH2(M = 2 M = 2),我们通过连续概率来组合验证符,并从第二次重复计算平均损失减少(图6 )。
概率接近零的托肯显示负收益或可忽略不计的收益,而平均收益则随着持续概率的总体增加。
在0.50.5的决定阈值下,相应的损失减少量接近于零。
这些结果支持决策者将更多的迭代指向能从中获取更多好处的标志的能力。

Token-level depth allocation .
We visualise token-level iteration depths in sampled responses from OlympiadBench, HumanEval and GPQA (Appendix C.4 ).
In the math and code examples, mathematical expressions and final code use fewer iterations than the preceding natural-language reasoning, whereas the QA example maintains greater depth throughout.

在数学和代码示例中,数学表达式和最终编码使用的迭代比之前的自然语言推理少,而QA示例则在整个过程中保持更大的深度.

blocks.en:
Cross-iteration attention .
We examine attention across iterations in three representative heads on validation sequences (Appendix C.5 ).
We find that different attention heads learn distinct iteration preferences: attending primarily to first-iteration states, later-iteration states, or both.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we study the test-time scaling of looped transformers introduced through post-training.
Existing looped models yield steeper accuracy–compute slopes than their non-looped baseline, yet remain less accurate at matched compute.
We therefore introduce TaH2, which post-trains adaptive looped transformers by jointly training the backbone and an iteration decider through lookahead depth supervision .
On AIME, TaH2 improves the slope by 53 % 53\% and exceeds Standard’s peak accuracy by about 3.4 3.4 points at matched compute.
Its gain over Standard grows from 2.8 2.8 to 3.9 3.9 points as the maximum iteration depth increases from 2 2 to 8 8 , and extends to larger models (4B and 8B) and other domains (code, QA and tool use).
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们研究通过培训后引入的循环变压器的测试时间缩放.
现有的环绕模型比其非导线基线的计算率更精确,但在匹配计算时仍然不太准确。
因此,我们引入了TaH2,通过对骨干和迭代决定器进行联合培训,通过对视向深度的监督,使后转向架适应性循环。
在 AIME 上, TaH2 将坡度提高 53% 53% , 并在匹配计算时超过标准峰值精度约3.43.4分。
其优于Standard的增益从2.82.8增长到3.93.9,因为最大迭代深度从2 2 增长到8 8 ,并扩展到更大的模型(4B和8B)和其他域(代码,QA和工具使用).

blocks.en:
Limitations .
(1) TaH2 incurs more training FLOPs than standard SFT (Appendix A.4.3 ).
But note that post-training requires substantially less compute than pretraining, making TaH2 a practical way to add adaptive depth to existing models.
(2) Our method is studied only under SFT; we leave its extension to on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning for future work.

(1) TaH2的训练FLOP比标准SFT(附录A.4.3.)要多.
但请注意,培训后需要的计算远低于预训,这使得TaH2成为在现有模型中增加适应深度的实用方法.
(2) 我们的方法只在SFT下研究;我们留待政策提炼和加强学习以后再研究。

blocks.en: A.2.1 Architecture Definitions
blocks.zh: A.2.1 结构定义

blocks.en:
Extended duo-causal attention .
Following TaH ( Fu et al., 2025b ) , each iteration keeps its own KV cache, and a query at token t t and depth m m attends to executed states at positions s ≤ t s\leq t and depths j ≤ m j\leq m (Figure 7 ).
Concatenating the per-iteration caches into one sequence turns this rule into a block-structured mask, so training and prefill process all tokens in parallel.
During training, a stopped token also computes a no-gradient lookahead iteration.
Lookahead queries cannot attend to other tokens’ lookahead states, but can attend to their executed states under the duo-causal rule.
Self-attention is retained, and all other attention follows the same position and depth constraints.
blocks.zh:
扩大双倍的注意力。

blocks.en:
We compare Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B-A22B as teachers, using responses generated from the same prompts.
We fine-tune Qwen3-1.7B-Base (Standard) on each response set with an identical training recipe and evaluate with a 32K output limit, temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p p 0.95 0.95 and top- k k 20 20 .

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他相关工作

blocks.en: This section extends Section 2 , grouped by test-time compute, recurrent design, adaptive depth and serving.
blocks.zh: 本节扩展了第2节,按试验时间计算、经常性设计、适应深度和服务分类。

blocks.en:
Test-time scaling .
Token-based scaling further differs in how it controls reasoning length and selects candidates.
Within a sequence, online confidence adjusts reasoning budgets ( Li et al., 2026c ) , while analyses of overthinking show that longer chains are not uniformly better ( Wu et al., 2025b ) .
Across candidates, process-reward search ( Guan et al., 2025 ) , likelihood-based sampling ( Karan and Du, 2025 ) and effort-aware sample scheduling ( Chen et al., 2026c ) guide exploration; call-count studies examine the non-monotone returns of additional LLM calls ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Within latent representations, methods compress multimodal reasoning ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , supervise parallel latent blocks ( Fan et al., 2026 ) , switch between latent and discrete reasoning by confidence ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , or add hidden sequence positions ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
ParScale instead adds parallel computation through multiple streams sharing model parameters ( Chen et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh:
测试时间缩放 。
基于托肯的缩放在如何控制推理长度和选择候选人方面进一步不同.
网络信心会调整推理预算(Li等人,2026c),
在整个候选者中,过程奖励搜索(Guan等人,2025年),基于概率的采样(Karan and Du,2025年)和努力意识的采样调度(Chen等人,2026年c)指导探索;呼叫计数研究检查额外LLM呼叫的非monoone回波(Chen等人,2024年).
在潜在表述范围内,方法压缩多式联运推理(沈等人,2025年),监督平行潜在块(范等人,2026年),通过信任在潜在推理和离散推理之间切换(徐等人,2026年),或增加隐藏序列位置(刘等人,2026年).
相反,Parscale 通过多个流共享模型参数添加并行计算 (Chen等人,2025a).

blocks.en:
Recurrent architectures .
Recurrent architectures differ in what they repeat and retain.
Universal Transformers share transformations across depth ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) , whereas block-recurrent Transformers carry recurrent state across sequence blocks ( Hutchins et al., 2022 ) .
Within depth recurrence, studies of growing and looping examine which blocks to repeat ( Kapl et al., 2026 ) ; Loopies repeats individual layers, offering an alternative to middle-block and full-stack recurrence ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
Pondering models feed predictions back as embeddings ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , CoTFormer interleaves intermediate representations as additional tokens ( Mohtashami et al., 2023 ) , and recursive reasoners refine latent states on structured tasks ( Ge et al., 2025 ; Ren and Liu, 2026 ; Baek et al., 2026 ; Altabaa et al., 2025 ) .
Theory examines the expressivity and memory requirements of repeated computation relative to explicit CoT ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Zhang, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
经常性建筑
重复和保留的内容不同。
通用变换器共享跨深度变换(Dehghani等人,2019年),而块-常态变换器则具有跨序列区块的反复状态(Hutchins等人,2022年).
在深度重复中,研究生长和循环检查哪些块要重复(Kapl等人,2026年);Loops重复单个层,为中层块和全层重现提供了替代品(Gao等人,2026年)。
Pondering models反馈预测作为嵌入物(Zeng等人,2025年),CoTFormer interleave 中间代表作为附加符号(Mohtashami等人,2023年),以及递归性理性器在结构化任务上完善潜在状态(Ge等人,2025年;Ren和Liu,2026年;Baek等人,2026年;Altabaa等人,2025年).
理论研究了重复计算相对于明示 CoT 的表达性和内存要求(Saunshi 等人,2025年;Zhang, 2026年).

blocks.en:
Scaling under resource constraints .
Scaling results depend on which resources are held fixed as recurrence increases.
Parcae studies compute allocation at fixed unique parameter count, allowing effective depth and per-token computation to grow ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) .
Iso-Depth instead fixes effective depth and quantifies the capacity retained when independent blocks are replaced by shared iterations ( Schwethelm et al., 2026b ) .
Sparse-layer studies examine how expert routing affects the cost of parameter sharing ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and Loopies compares layer-looped MoE models under matched wall-clock training budgets ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
SMELT matches per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters and KV cache, then fits separate pretraining scaling laws for looped and non-looped MoE models ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
Architectural syntheses likewise distinguish parameter efficiency from computational cost ( Huang et al., 2026a ) .
Our comparison varies output-token budgets after post-training and measures reasoning accuracy against decoding FLOPs per response, complementing these architectural and pretraining studies.
blocks.zh:
在资源限制下扩大规模
扩大成果取决于资源是否随着重复增加而固定。
Parcae研究在固定独有参数计数时计算分配,使有效深度和按键计算得以增长(Prairie等人,2026年).
相反,Iso-Depth修正了有效深度,并量化了独立区块被共享迭代所取代时保留的能力(Schwethelm等人,2026b )。
Sparse-layer研究考察专家的路由如何影响参数共享的成本(Lee等人,2026年),Loopies在匹配的墙点培训预算下比较了层层式的MOE模型(Gao等人,2026年).
SMELT匹配每盘FLOP,总非嵌入参数和KV缓存,然后为循环式和非螺旋式的MOE模型分别匹配预训练缩放定律(Wang等人,2026b ).
建筑综合也区分了参数效率与计算成本(Huang等人,2026a.)。
我们的比较在培训后和衡量推理的准确性之后,对每个答复的FLOP进行解码,从而补充了这些建筑学和预培训研究。

blocks.en:
Depth scaling and stability .
Increasing the depth used during training and executing more iterations than were seen during training are distinct settings.
Ouro, Parcae and STARS report saturation or degradation when inference extends beyond the trained depth regime ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Prairie et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) ; RecurTrace, TaH and code-model studies also document non-monotone returns from additional iterations ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Fu et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026a ) .
Stability methods, including STARS, modify residual scaling, input injection or recurrent dynamics ( Li et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Fu et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Labovich, 2026 ) , while readout analyses show that per-loop supervision constrains only the state variables exposed to the readout ( Sharma and Vu, 2026 ) .
Mechanistic studies distinguish state convergence from predictive improvement ( Blayney et al., 2026 ; Viakhirev et al., 2026 ) , examining two-scale dynamics ( Pappone et al., 2025 ) , dynamical regimes ( Kim, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , Jacobian structure ( Wang and Reid, 2026 ) and links between latent and verbal reasoning ( Chen et al., 2026a ) .
Our depth-scaling experiments increase the maximum iteration depth used in training; Appendix B.2 examines inference beyond it.
blocks.zh:
深度缩放和稳定性
增加培训期间使用的深度,执行比培训期间更多的迭代,是不同的环境。
Ouro、Parcae和STARS报告,在推论超出训练深度制度时饱和或退化(Zhu等人,2025年;Prairie等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年b年);RecurTrace、TaH和编码模型研究也记录了额外迭代产生的非杂质返回(Wang等人,2026年c;Fu等人,2025年b;Yang等人,2026年a年)。
稳定方法,包括STARS,修改残留缩放、输入注入或反复动态(Li等人,2026b;Wang等人,2026a;Fu等人,2026b; Yang et al., 2026b; Labovich, 2026 ),而读出分析显示,每页监督只限制暴露于读出(Sharma and Vu, 2026)的状态变量.
机械学研究将状态趋同与预测性改进区分开来(Blayney等人,2026年;Viakhirev等人,2026年),研究双尺度动力学. (Pappone等人,2025年),动态制度(金,2026年;张等人,2026年),雅各别结构(王和瑞德,2026年),潜伏推理与口头推理之间的联系(陈等人,2026年a). 。 。 。
我们的深度测距实验增加了训练中使用的最大迭代深度;附录B.2审查了超出这一深度的推论。

blocks.en:
Recurrent states and output aggregation .
State design determines which information remains available across iterations.
Memory highways ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and depth attention ( Knupp et al., 2026 ) expose earlier states, while anchored injection ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , discrete–continuous channels ( Fu et al., 2026a ) and gated modulation ( Hegazy et al., 2026 ) alter state updates.
Other work changes the repeated computation through mixer-only loops ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , multi-token guidance ( Shomali et al., 2026 ) or denoising objectives ( Suleymanzade et al., 2026 ) .
For output aggregation, PonderLM-3 weights hidden states by predicted depth probabilities ( Li et al., 2026a ) ; Adaptive Latent CoT and Adaptive Loops and Memory use halting probabilities to combine intermediate states ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Frey et al., 2026 ) .
TaH2 uses input injection between iterations and mixes output distributions across executed depths, with the final depth absorbing the remaining stopping mass.
blocks.zh:
经常状态和产出汇总
国家设计确定哪些信息仍可在整个版本中提供。
记忆高速公路(Yu等人,2025年)和深度关注(Knupp等人,2026年)暴露了更早的状态,同时锚定注射(Kim等人,2026年),离散连续通道(Fu等人,2026年a年)和闸门调制(Hegazy等人,2026年)改变状态更新.
其他作品通过搅拌机唯一循环(Lin等人,2026年),多托肯制导(Shomali等人,2026年)或去诺化目标(Suleymanzade等人,2026年)来改变重复的计算.
关于产出汇总,PonderLM-3按预测深度概率的隐藏状态(Li等人,2026a) ; 适应性Latet CoT和适应性Loops和记忆使用停止概率结合中间状态(Zeng等人,2026年;Frey等人,2026年).
TaH2使用迭代之间的输入注入,并混合跨执行深度的输出分布,最后深度吸收剩余停止质量.

blocks.en:
Post-training recurrence into pretrained LLMs .
Conversion methods differ in how they preserve and adapt pretrained computation, paralleling upcycling into MoE or deeper models ( Komatsuzaki et al., 2022 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024a ) .
Beyond the conversions in Section 2 , path-preserving initialisation retains single-pass behaviour ( Shapiro, 2026 ) , a trainable recurrent module can be attached to a frozen backbone ( Panwar et al., 2026 ) , and middle layers can be repeated without training ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
Retrofitted recurrence has been evaluated on math and compositional tool use ( McLeish et al., 2025 ; Popescu et al., 2026a ) .
DND learns selective recomputation with routing regularisation and target selection ratios ( Chen et al., 2025b ) ; TaH trains a decider from offline mismatch labels in a separate stage ( Fu et al., 2025b ) .
TaH2 instead jointly adapts the backbone and decider using online supervision of iteration gains.
blocks.zh:
培训后再培训为预训课程。
转换方法在如何保存和调整预先经过训练的计算方法方面有所不同,它们平行地将升降循环转化为MOE或更深的模型(Komatsuzaki等人,2022年;Kim等人,2023年;Wu等人,2024年a年)。
除了第2节中的转换外,路径保留初始化保留单通道行为(Shapiro, 2026年),一个可训练的经常性模块可以附加在冷冻的主干上(Panwar等人, 2026年),中间层可以重复而不训练(Chen等人, 2026年b).
已经对数学和组成工具的使用进行了重新适应的重复性评价(McLeish等人,2025年;Popescu等人,2026a年)。
DND学习有选择的复标,采用路线规范化和目标选择比率(Chen等人,2025年b);TaH从离线错配标签中单独培训一个决定者(Fu等人,2025年b).
TaH2转而联合调整骨干和决定者,使用对迭代收益的在线监督.

blocks.en:
Dimensions of adaptive computation .
Adaptive architectures select computation within layers or across depth.
Along width, sparse MoE routing selects experts for each token ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) ; ZEDA further varies expert activation through zero-expert injection and self-distillation ( Lv et al., 2026 ) .
Its token-level visualisations show reduced computation for mathematical expressions and code fragments relative to natural-language reasoning, relating compute allocation to response content.
Along depth, LayerSkip enables early exits ( Elhoushi et al., 2024 ) , while MoD routes selected tokens through each layer ( Raposo et al., 2024 ) .
Other approaches change computation by routing to larger models ( Fu et al., 2025a ) or grouping tokens into concepts ( Huang et al., 2026b ; Qu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
适应性计算的各个方面
适应性架构在层内或跨深度选择计算.
ZEDA通过零专家注射和自我消化(Lv等人,2026年)。
它的符号级可视化显示相对于自然语言推理的数学表达式和代码片段的计算减少,与响应内容的计算分配有关.
沿着深度,LayerSkip使早期出口成为可能(Elhoushi等人,2024年),而MOD路线则通过每层选择符(Raposo等人,2024年).
其他方法通过径向较大的模型(Fu等人,2025a)或将符号组合成概念(Huang等人,2026b;Qu等人,2025)来改变计算方式.

blocks.en:
Adaptive iteration depth .
Within looped models, depth decisions differ in granularity and timing.
LoopFormer follows a user-specified sequence budget ( Jeddi et al., 2026 ) ; T-LoopFormer and PonderLM-3 predict token depths from initial states ( Yu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026a ) ; ANIRA compares such initial allocation with decisions after each iteration ( Moosa et al., 2026 ) .
Training signals provide a separate distinction.
AdaPonderLM trains iterative gates with a compute penalty ( Song et al., 2026 ) , whereas RL-Halting uses terminal rewards to learn sequence-level stopping ( Kuo et al., 2026 ) .
Explicit gain supervision is also used by Ouro’s second-stage gate and RecurTrace’s separately trained sequence-level head ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) ; TaH2 derives token-level targets online from the evolving backbone during joint training.
Alternatives use a learned confidence head ( Park et al., 2026 ) or convergence-based stopping rules ( Geiping et al., 2025a ; Logan, 2026 ; Movahedi et al., 2026 ; Pappone et al., 2025 ) .
Gate collapse has been reported for Ouro, RecurTrace and retrofitted models ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Shapiro, 2026 ) under particular objectives and training settings, and we observe it for Ouro’s Stage I in our post-training setting (Appendix A.2.1 ).
Controlled diagnoses examine how jointly learned gates affect training trajectories ( Popescu et al., 2026b ) , while analyses of hierarchical recurrent models find settings where fixed maximum depth outperforms adaptive halting ( Ge et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
适应性迭代深度 。
在循环模型中,深度决定在颗粒性和时间上有所不同。
LoopFormer遵循用户指定的序列预算(Jeddi等人,2026年);T-LoopFormer和PonderLM-3预测初始状态的征兆深度(Yu等人,2026年a; Li等人,2026a;ANIRA将这种初步分配与每次重复后的决定进行比较(Moosa等人,2026年)。
培训信号提供了单独的区别。
阿达庞德 LM列车的迭代门带有计算罚(Song等人,2026年),而RL-Halting则使用终端奖励来学习序列级停(Kuo等人,2026年).
Ouro的第二阶段大门和RecurTrace经过单独培训的序列级头(Zhu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年c年)也使用明确的收益监督;TaH2在联合培训期间从不断发展的骨干骨干线上衍生出象征级目标。
替代品使用一个学习过的信任头(Park等人,2026年)或基于趋同的停止规则(Geiping等人,2025年a;Logan,2026年;Movahedi等人,2026年;Pappone等人,2025年) 。
据报道,Ouro、RecurTraces和改装过的模型(Zhu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年c;Shapiro,2026年)在具体目标和培训环境下出现故障,我们在培训后环境中为Ouo的第一阶段进行观察(附录A.2.1)。
受控制的诊断研究了共同学习的大门如何影响培训轨迹(Popescu等人,2026年b),而分级的经常性模型分析发现,固定最大深度表现超过适应性停顿的环境(Ge等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Serving adaptive depth .
Whether FLOPs savings become wall-clock gains depends on execution.
Continuous depth batching schedules tokens at different depths in shared passes ( Bae et al., 2024 ; Schwethelm et al., 2026a ) , cross-loop parallelism and diffusion-style samplers overlap iterations across tokens ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Geiping et al., 2025b ) , and cross-loop KV sharing or compression bounds memory ( Vendrell et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; O’Neill and Reid, 2026 ) .
CHASE adapts training to the missing states left by skipped iterations under early exit ( Yu et al., 2026b ) .
We report decoding FLOPs as the primary metric and verify throughput with a depth-batched engine (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
提供适应深度。
FLOPs的储蓄是否成为时钟收益取决于执行.
在共享通行证(Bae等人,2024年;Schwethelm等人,2026年a)中,连续的深度分批时间表符号,跨纬度平行和扩散式采样器相互重叠,跨纬度重复(Wu等人,2025年a;Geiping等人,2025年b),跨纬度KV共享或压缩约束内存(Vendrell等人,2026年;Deng等人,2026年;O ' Neill和Reid,2026年)。
CHASE根据早期退出(Yu等人,2026年b)跳过迭代后留下的状态调整训练.
我们把FLOP的解码作为主要衡量标准,并用深斗发动机核查吞吐量(第5.2节)。
